static_findings: Base Position constructor uses original gains before any overlay; GroundController aliases stay on untouched original arrays.
_overlay creates dict plus independent readonly tau array, assigns LEG only, copies WHEEL values without adding zero; no q_start/K/tau_eq/ref mutation.
First-push overlay does not require launched; inherited Position next-tick/timeout and V1 state guard still decide the phase/fault.
Exactly one super.command call under try/finally restores self.g/end identity for normal return and exceptions; no post-torque compensation.
Disabled/operator-disabled paths do not require gas data or change legacy arithmetic; only new diagnostic fields are appended.
No AIR002 inheritance, runtime gas FK, changed air/capture expressions, observer schedule or new contact permission.
pending_before_admission: Code adds +gas[LEG]; C table must explicitly mean positive generalized gas force in output-joint Nm, not already-negated motor compensation; validate independent signs and actual endpoint q.
New entry must pass locked start/end arrays with source/table receipt SHA and feature/config/runtime manifest binding; candidate alone is not a provenance/physics certificate.
Endpoint delta log is nominal pre-PD/preclip algebra, not measured applied torque/power or a promise of exact arithmetic difference after saturation.
